questions.question: What is notable about Psalm 117?
options: It is the shortest psalm and chapter in the Bible
It is the only psalm ever written by the wise King Solomon
It is the central chapter of the whole Bible
It is the longest of all the psalms by far
questions.answer: It is the shortest psalm and chapter in the Bible

questions.question: Whom does Psalm 117 call to praise the LORD?
The psalm says great is the LORD's steadfast love toward us, and his faithfulness endures forever.
Praise the LORD, all _____! Extol him, all peoples!
Great is his steadfast love toward us, and the _____ of the LORD endures forever.
